topic: Review the sk-design-diagram skill at .opencode/skills/sk-design/sk-design-diagram: its twelve checker families and mutation suite, the DESIGN.md applicator and its gates, the 38 diagram forms, the style-reference bundle that now owns colour, and every reference document. Report P0/P1/P2 findings with file:line evidence.

focus: D1 Correctness + D2 Security - the twelve checker families, the corpus harness, the mutation suite, and the DESIGN.md applicator's derivation, gates and write path

findingDetails.title: Applicator gates only the roles whose bytes changed, so a themed worked form can ship values its own gate would refuse
findingDetails.evidence: remapLiterals returns before recording the role (:804 precedes :805) and is the only contribution a block-less form makes to used (:819-822); validateRoles then gates that list alone (:974). With a probe reference whose dark ground moved, sequence-oauth-dark.html yields used=[paper] and 0 gate failures while shipping ink at 1.29:1 and accent at 1.75:1, and starter-dark.html from the same reference yields used=[paper,ink,muted,accent,link] with 5 gate failures.
findingDetails.recommendation: Feed validateRoles the derived skin role set (or the set the delivery actually paints) instead of rendered.used, or amend references/design-md-theming.md:210,220 to scope gating to repainted values.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Reachability path read end to end (substituteBlock :735-763, remapLiterals :778-809, single validateRoles call site :974); identity run over all 38 forms executed in memory to confirm the gap cannot show under --default.

findingDetails.title: Token source's dark skin declares five roles while both colour documents declare ten, and an undocumented dark value ships in a corpus form
findingDetails.evidence: skins.dark.roles = paper, ink, muted, accent, link; derivation-record.md:44-56 and style-guide.md:37-48 also declare paper-2 #393e53, soft #8e98ac, rule, rule-solid and accent-tint rgba(240,138,89,0.10). #393e53 and #8e98ac occur in no form; the two rgba dark values occur only in sequence-oauth-dark.html, which has no palette block so derivation-gates returns at :42. A themed dark block declaring the documented paper-2 or soft is refused at derivation-gates.cjs:73.
findingDetails.recommendation: Either add the five roles to the dark skin of the token source, or reduce the two documents to the five roles the source carries and record the two rgba literals as roles so they can be measured and repainted.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Palette dumped programmatically for all three skins; every declared dark value grepped across assets/diagrams (0 hits for two, one file for two); derivation-gates early-return and unknown-role branch read.

findingDetails.title: node-budget asserts nothing on the shipped corpus yet reports 38 assertions
findingDetails.evidence: grep -l for data-diagram-node and data-diagram-arrow across all 38 forms returns no files and every count is 0; the family can only record when a count exceeds NODE_BUDGET=9 or ARROW_BUDGET=12, and tally(NAME,1) is called unconditionally per file (:24), so check-diagram-corpus.cjs:162-166 prints 38 assertions for a rule that no shipped form exercises.
findingDetails.recommendation: Report compared values rather than per-file invocations for this family, and record the corpus-wide signal absence where the summary is printed, or tag the forms so the budget is measurable.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Corpus grepped for both attributes and for any indirect node tag (labels, roles) - none exists; the family comment's own concession and the empty NEEDS_AN_EYE exemption map read.

findingDetails.title: Recorded departure's gate field is never consulted, so one departure excuses another gate
findingDetails.evidence: All three readers match on skin + role + rounded ratio only: apply-design-md.cjs:685, apply-diagram-tokens.cjs:162, families/derivation-gates.cjs:80. The palette records departures[0].gate = markOnPaper for the light accent, yet this run printed DEPARTURE light accent 2.86:1 below textOnMark 4.5.
findingDetails.recommendation: Include gate equality in the departure match at all three sites, or drop the field from the token source and state that a departure excuses the role rather than the gate.
findingDetails.scopeProof: All three departure readers located by grep over scripts/; observed note captured from a validateRoles call in this session.

findingDetails.title: No check reaches inline JavaScript, event-handler attributes or javascript: URLs
findingDetails.evidence: SCRIPT_BODIES blanks script bodies before the remote-reference scan and no other family reads script, on* or javascript: targets; SKILL.md:237 promises a self-contained file with no required JavaScript, and apply-design-md.cjs copies bytes through, so a themed delivery inherits whatever the source form carries. Grep shows the corpus itself carries no script element.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add a family that reports an inline script, an on* handler or a javascript: target as a delivery-contract violation, or state in the delivery contract that inline script is permitted and why the package does not care.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Family inventory walked for any reader of script/handler markup (none); corpus grepped for <script (0 files); applicator's render path read to confirm byte pass-through.

results.summary: Documented gate scope is wider than the implemented gate surface; demonstrated with one reference returning FAILED on a starter and PASSED on a worked form.
The stated complexity budget has no falsifiable check on the shipped corpus.

noveltyJustification: Three P1s and two P2s, each anchored to lines read in this iteration and, for F001 and F003, to output produced by executing the shipped modules; two candidate P0s were downgraded after the counterevidence pass.

focus: D3 Traceability + D4 Maintainability - the documents that state what is enforced (theming contract, derivation record, style guide, form-library index, SKILL.md checklist) and the parts of the checker surface no family can reach

findingDetails.title: Theming contract documents --forms base names that do not exist, so the printed command fails
findingDetails.evidence: The document names template, template-dark, template-full and template-terminal; the shipped files are starter-light/dark/full/terminal (assets/diagrams/README.md:32) and formNames resolves <form>.html against disk (apply-design-md.cjs:881-892). Observed: run(['--default','--forms','template-full','--out',...]) throws diagram form does not exist: .../assets/diagrams/template-full.html, and the transcript quoted at :224 names the same vanished file.
findingDetails.recommendation: Rename the four base names in the argument table, the example command and the failure transcript to starter-*, or add an alias table the applicator actually honours.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Document read in full; the command in it executed and its error captured; the corpus listing and the applicator's name resolution both read.

findingDetails.title: Derivation record claims the corpus check enforces applicator byte equality, and no checker path invokes an applicator
findingDetails.evidence: Record section 6 states the corpus check requires the applicator's result to equal the shipped bytes and that a drifting value fails by name. check-diagram-corpus.cjs:27 requires only color-gates.cjs, no family requires either applicator, and the only identity procedure is the manual copy-diff at design-md-theming.md:84-90. The property itself was verified to hold today: 38 of 38 forms byte-identical under --default, 0 gate failures.
findingDetails.recommendation: Either add the identity invocation to the corpus check or the test suite, or rewrite section 6 to describe the manual procedure and say the relationship is upheld by review rather than by the check.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Checker and every family's require list read; test suite listing checked for an identity case; the property itself executed in memory over all 38 forms.

findingDetails.title: Two of five series colours fall below the 4.5:1 gate the style guide says all five clear, and the roles are ungated
findingDetails.evidence: Measured with scripts/color-gates.cjs against white (the metric derivation-record.md:96-103 uses: the second series moved 4.44:1 to 4.56:1 against white): series-1 3.49:1, series-2 4.56:1, series-3 2.90:1, series-4 4.53:1, series-5 5.58:1. series-1..5 are in the palette's gates.ungated list and both readers skip ungated roles (derivation-gates.cjs:87, apply-design-md.cjs:640), so no code path measures the claim; chooseSeries requires only markOnPaper (3.0).
findingDetails.recommendation: State the metric in one place, re-measure the five values against it, and either gate series roles that carry a label or drop the claim that they clear a gate nothing applies to them.
findingDetails.scopeProof: All five light and five dark series values recomputed with the shipped contrast function against white, the light ink, and the 0.18-alpha composite; ungated list dumped from the palette; both readers' skip branches read.

findingDetails.title: Form-library index claims two rules the corpus check cannot hold
findingDetails.evidence: The index says the corpus check holds accessibility wiring, one skin per file, tokens from the palette source and connectors that meet their targets. The checker's header names pairwise connector geometry as out of reach (check-diagram-corpus.cjs:9-13), no family reads a connector endpoint against a box edge, and the skin and palette claims hold only for files with a palette block - derivation-gates returns at :42 for the 34 worked forms.
findingDetails.recommendation: Narrow the sentence to the families that exist and move the connector claim to the capture review, where the checker's own header says it is held.
findingDetails.scopeProof: All twelve families walked for a connector-endpoint or literal-vs-skin check (none); derivation-gates early-return confirmed; README paragraph scope read to rule out a starters-only reading.

findingDetails.title: An unreachable exemption in the grid family
findingDetails.evidence: The clause (tag === 'rect' && attr.startsWith('r')) iterates GEOMETRY.rect = ['x','y','width','height'], so attr never starts with r and the clause can never be true. The corner-radius exemption it was written for is enforced by omission instead.
findingDetails.recommendation: Delete the clause or add rx/ry to the rect attribute list with the exemption stated, matching how node-budget.cjs:18-19 removed its own unreachable exemption.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Attribute list and the loop that consumes it read together; the same pattern's removal elsewhere cited as the packet's own standard.

findingDetails.title: Shared context exposes members no family reads, and a collection name outlives the rule it described
findingDetails.evidence: crypto is required at :26 and passed in shared at :137 but read nowhere in the harness or the families; templateDir and exampleDir at :138 are aliases of formDir that no family reads. label-mask-clearance.cjs:133 declares short and pushes every connector into it (:167) after the header explains the rule is now a clearance rather than an overlap test on short runs.
findingDetails.recommendation: Drop the unused import and aliases, or document them as the intended extension surface; rename short to what it holds.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Every shared member grepped across families/*.cjs and the harness; label-mask-clearance's push site and header read together.

findingDetails.title: Technical checklist requires a hardcoded paper hex the style guide forbids
findingDetails.evidence: The checklist asks for an opaque fill=#f5f5f5 mask rect, which is only the light paper; the dark paper is #2d3142 and the terminal paper #141414 (style-guide.md:37, palette skins). It also contradicts ALWAYS rule 5 at SKILL.md:267. The corpus and the checker do the right thing: label-mask-clearance.cjs:38 accepts var(--color-paper), var(--paper) and both dark fills.
findingDetails.recommendation: Rewrite the item to name the paper role rather than the light hex.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Checklist item, the token rule it contradicts, the style guide's three paper values, the checker's ground-fill pattern and the dark forms' actual mask fills all read.

results.summary: One documented procedure cannot execute (F006) and one enforcement claim has no enforcing code (F007); the property behind the second was verified to hold today.
One checklist item contradicts the token rule it sits beside (F012); the complexity-budget item rests on a family with no signal on the shipped corpus (F003).
The catalog and the checker agree on twelve families, a count both derive from disk.
Scenarios map to executable paths and the judgment band the checker's header also names; no scenario promises an automated check that does not exist.

noveltyJustification: Four P1s and three P2s from reading claims against shipped artifacts: form names against disk, a gate claim against the shipped colour arithmetic, a coverage claim against the family inventory. No iteration-1 finding repeated; every finding is a document-versus-machinery gap or a naming/dead-surface defect.
